role: independent read-only review of root-authored proposed state blueprint
scope: Proposed isolated human-referee tabletop state and its targeted integration test; no live world/content/rules engine review
verdict: one type/schema alignment fix recommended before calling the interface coherent

findings.title: TypeScript permits dual or absent item custody rejected by JSON Schema
findings.evidence: Both a held item also carrying a location ID and an item with neither custody field typecheck successfully (probe exit 0), while the real JSON Schema rejects both.
findings.impact: Typed consumers can construct an invalid referee record without a compile-time error despite the owner requesting clean strict TypeScript/JSON interfaces. No runtime authoritative write is introduced.
findings.recommendation: Represent item placement with a union: {custodian_actor_id:string,location_id:null} | {custodian_actor_id:null,location_id:string}; retain shared item fields. Add both negative compile examples and both JSON mutation cases.

checks.isolation: authoritative:false, source:human_referee and strict unknown-field rejection; no import or ledger action API added
checks.custody: Schema XOR correct; TypeScript mismatch reported
checks.life: No second actor alive flag; schema rejects adding it
checks.integer_bounds: Safe-integer endpoints and positive/nonnegative fields reject tested fractional/overflow/negative values

intentional_limits: Unique/referenced IDs, full workspace identity, HP<=maximum, project progress limits, ownership/capacity and chronology are explicitly future semantic checks; the current schema permits some invalid semantic states and documentation accurately says so.
JSON Schema alone accepts JavaScript negative zero; a future importer needs canonical/passive DTO validation before state admission. No importer currently exists.
Array bounds and free-text ruling results make this a bounded referee record, not an immutable replay ledger.
Tabletop HP, positions and resource counters remain outside existing authoritative state; new causal ruleset/migration remains a required Phase 2 decision.
All-zero pack hash is clearly labeled an example placeholder, not accepted source provenance.
